items.html: And afterwards he brought out the discernments of the externality in order to clothe him. First he brought out lights from the inner general AB, which are the hairs of the Keter that surround his head from the outside, down to the forehead and to the ears, as is known. And afterwards he brought out the hairs of the beard, which are extended from the general SAG that is called Nekudim, from which the generality of the three Mochin was made.
